supporting_observations.claim: Repeated failed logons for svc-claimsync are visible on FILE-HD-01, beginning at 13:31 and continuing at roughly one-minute intervals through at least 13:46. The failures report an incorrect password and identify FILE-HD-01 as the workstation, with source address 10.30.20.20.
Domain-controller records corroborate failed authentication for svc-claimsync during the same period, including bad-password results from 4776 and pre-authentication failures from 4771.

The observed timing and cadence are consistent with the provided change calendar and service inventory: the password rotation was scheduled for 13:30, and ClaimSync re-authenticates each minute. This makes a stale password in the repeatedly running job a specific plausible explanation, but the records do not identify the ClaimSync job as the source of the attempts.

known_telemetry_limitations: Although the requested review window ends at 14:20 UTC, the supplied authentication records end at 13:46 UTC; activity for the remainder of the window is not shown.
The FILE-HD-01 failure records name lsass.exe, which handles authentication, but do not identify the application, service, or scheduled task that supplied the credentials.
The supplied records establish failures but do not establish whether there were successful logons or other authentication activity in the full alert window.
claims_not_established: That the failed attempts were generated by the legitimate ClaimSync job rather than another process or actor on FILE-HD-01.
That the password rotation occurred as scheduled, or when and how the ClaimSync job was updated afterward.
That no successful or suspicious authentication occurred during the portion of the review window not represented in the supplied records.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the svc-claimsync password-change audit record and ClaimSync configuration or job-update logs around 13:30 UTC.
Collect FILE-HD-01 task, service, and application execution logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC to attribute the recurring authentication attempts to the ClaimSync job or another process.
Collect complete FILE-HD-01 and DC-HD-01 authentication records for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including any successful logons.
unrelated_findings: At 13:39:31, WS-LPARK-01 recorded an explicit-credential-use event for svc-claimsync targeting PROXY-HD-01, attributed to C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe. This is separate from the recurring failures sourced from FILE-HD-01; the record alone does not establish a successful logon or malicious activity. Review it in a separate ticket. (T002-00019)
